newsitem.title: CANADA: Westmin bid for Gibraltar worth C$307 mln.
newsitem.headline: Westmin bid for Gibraltar worth C$307 mln.

text.p: Westmin Resources Ltd and Gibraltar Mines Ltd said on Tuesday Westmin will offer to acquire all of the shares of Gibraltar for about C$307 million, or C$8.85 per share.
Placer Dome Inc, which holds about 30.8 percent of Gibraltar, agreed to tender its shares to the offer.

They said the consideration will consist of C$8.85 in cash per Gibraltar common shares up to a maximum aggregate payable to all Gibraltar shareholders of C$86,653,000, or 1.180 common shares of Westmin per Gibraltar common share based on a Westmin price of C$7.50 per share.

Westmin and Gibraltar said that if all Gibraltar shareholders elected to receive cash, the consideration would be prorated as to C$2.50 in cash and 0.847 common shares of Westmin per Gibraltar common share.
Gibraltar was up 1.70 to 8 in active early trading in Toronto, while Westmin fell 0.50 to 7 in thin volume.
Placer, which holds 10,156,101 Gibraltar shares, agreed to take its consideration in the form of cash to the fullest extent available, Westmin said.
Gibraltar's total outstanding shares on a fully diluted basis are about 34.7 million shares.
